race.title: Racing To School Reaches 25 Years Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: SACRE CHEF sets a high standard and can get off the mark. Hurdling newcomer Magical Merlot looks most interesting of the remainder. SACRE CHEF (FR) MAGICAL MERLOT POETRY OF TIME
race.bettingForecast: Sacre Chef (5/4), Magical Merlot (3/1), Poetry Of Time (3/1), See Blue (12/1), Elm Creek (14/1), Al Khawaaneej (25/1), Positive Thoughts (25/1), Gwen's Girl (33/1), Risk Averse Rebel (66/1), Cospicua (66/1), Retro Rocket (100/1)
